tiles.name: Cost, rolling 24 h (USD, root runs)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['agw.cost.usd'])), 2) AS cost_usd FROM $__sourceTable WHERE Timestamp > fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND ServiceName IN ('agw', 'agw-audio') AND SpanName LIKE 'agw.run %' AND SpanAttributes['agw.run.id'] = SpanAttributes['agw.run.root_id']

tiles.name: Cost per day (USD, root runs: sum of agw.cost.usd)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS ts, multiIf(SpanAttributes['agw.purpose'] = 'eval', 'eval', SpanAttributes['agw.purpose'] LIKE 'software-factory.%', 'factory', 'other') AS Kind, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['agw.cost.usd'])), 2) AS cost_usd FROM $__sourceTable WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('agw', 'agw-audio') AND SpanName LIKE 'agw.run %' AND SpanAttributes['agw.run.id'] = SpanAttributes['agw.run.root_id'] GROUP BY ts, Kind ORDER BY ts LIMIT 2000

tiles.name: Workflows with every run failed in 6 h (alert: 1 or more)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() AS dead_workflows FROM (SELECT SpanAttributes['agw.workflow.id'] AS w, count() AS runs, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS failed FROM $__sourceTable WHERE Timestamp > fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND ServiceName IN ('agw', 'agw-audio') AND SpanName LIKE 'agw.run %' AND SpanAttributes['agw.run.id'] = SpanAttributes['agw.run.root_id'] AND SpanAttributes['agw.purpose'] NOT IN ('verify', 'eval') GROUP BY w HAVING runs >= 3 AND failed = runs)

tiles.name: Workflows by runs and failures, last 6 h (3 or more runs)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT SpanAttributes['agw.workflow.id'] AS Workflow, count() AS Runs, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS Failed, round(Failed / Runs, 2) AS FailedShare FROM $__sourceTable WHERE Timestamp > fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND ServiceName IN ('agw', 'agw-audio') AND SpanName LIKE 'agw.run %' AND SpanAttributes['agw.run.id'] = SpanAttributes['agw.run.root_id'] AND SpanAttributes['agw.purpose'] NOT IN ('verify', 'eval') GROUP BY Workflow HAVING Runs >= 3 ORDER BY FailedShare DESC, Runs DESC LIMIT 30

tiles.name: Gateway requests by route
Gateway error spans (alert: 5 or more per 15 min, modelpick probes excluded)
Gateway errors by caller and status (modelpick excluded)
Gateway time to first token, p95 by route
Web capability failures by reason

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT SpanAttributes['agw.workflow.id'] AS Workflow, substring(replaceOne(SpanAttributes['agw.error.message'], 'step "call" failed (error): ', ''), 1, 70) AS Reason, count() AS Runs FROM $__sourceTable WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'agw' AND SpanName LIKE 'agw.run cap.web.%' AND SpanAttributes['agw.run.id'] = SpanAttributes['agw.run.root_id'] AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND SpanAttributes['agw.purpose'] NOT IN ('verify', 'eval') GROUP BY Workflow, Reason ORDER BY Runs DESC LIMIT 30

tiles.name: Web fetch and read runs by leg (cached or not)

select.where: ServiceName = 'agw' AND SpanName IN ('agw.run cap.web.fetch', 'agw.run cap.web.read') AND SpanAttributes['agw.web.leg'] != ''

tiles.name: Gateway spend per pool per day (USD; stands in for pool credit left)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS ts, SpanAttributes['agw.gateway.pool'] AS Pool, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['agw.cost.usd'])), 2) AS spend_usd FROM $__sourceTable WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'agw-gateway' GROUP BY ts, Pool ORDER BY ts LIMIT 2000
